## FAQ

### What is the Investing.com Earnings Calendar?

The Earnings Calendar is a free tool that tracks earnings report dates for publicly traded companies worldwide. It displays EPS and Revenue forecasts alongside actual results once released, so you can compare analyst expectations with reported outcomes in a single view.

# Earnings Calendar

Use our Earnings Calendar to track forecasts for quarterly and annual earnings reports as well as actual outcomes from companies worldwide. See previous and actual earnings per share upon release as well as expected EPS prior to release. Read More

 Expiration [...] Most publicly traded companies report earnings four times a year, once per fiscal quarter. Earnings season typically begins a few weeks after each quarter ends, with the busiest reporting periods falling in January, April, July, and October. Not all companies report on the same date, so the Earnings Calendar helps you track which companies are reporting on any given day.
